notes.title: Yapori Minigames Updates and News
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I want to let you know that there will still be updates over time for Yapori Minigames, we are working hard to update the game, adding new minigames, game modes and much more

Currently the game has had its price reduced, and is currently 20% off, the promotion runs until January

That's it, thanks for reading

notes.title: A Big Change for Yapori Minigames
notes.notes: Hello everyone, I come to say that soon Yapori Minigames will have a big change, the game will no longer be free, and will be paid for very soon, I also want to thank the many people who played the game, there were more than 60 downloads , and I couldn't be happier about it, thank you everyone, see you soon.

notes.title: 0.10: English Localization, more skins and optimizations.
notes.notes:
This update brings the following improvements:

[list]
[*] [b]English Localization[/b]: the game is now available to play in English.
[*] [b]10 New Skins[/b]: unlock new skins as you level up.
[*] [b]Optimizations[/b]: game textures have been optimized to use less space and memory, and we've cleaned up the game code for better performance.
[*] [b]Offline Mode[/b]: the game now works properly without internet connection.
[/list]

More minigames will be added in the future. Thank you for reading this!

notes.title: 0.9: Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
Multiplayer is now available on Yapori Minigames, you can now play with up to five friends in the same match!
